name: Aero XP
texts: (Designed for the aero basic theme) Changes the colors of the UI. For the custom setting, edit the file titled _UserPrefs.css in the skin's root folder.
A steam skin that replicates the ui of Windows Media Player 11 on Windows XP.
Change the font of the GUI.
Change the library background of the Media center theme.
Change the style of the bottom buttons.
Change the transparency of the library text headers.
Changes the menu bar resource to the one from vista/7.
Enables transparency in steam's in game overlay.
Force fit command bar username width
Force fit the username in the command bar to 500px, might be useful for long usernames.
Hides the extra controls in the titlebar such as big picture, notificactions, and news.
Moves the navigation bar above the menu bar.
Replaces loading circles with their aero counterparts from vista, (still being worked on, might be buggy).
Select a friends list UI Style.
Select if you use steam in small mode.
Select if you use steam with the console enabled.
Shows the game buttons in the What's New Page.
To clean up the ui some scrollbars hidden, uncheck this to restore them.
